title: ShoppingListFiles helper
description: Add `CookbookApp/ShoppingLists/ShoppingListFiles.swift`. Encapsulates: (1) discovering all `.md` files in the security-scoped folder URL, reverse-sorted by `URLResourceValues.contentModificationDate`; (2) deriving the display name (filename minus `.md`); (3) reading and writing file text; (4) a shared `RelativeDateTimeFormatter` instance. All file I/O is bracketed with `startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()` / `stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource()` as required for iOS bookmark-resolved URLs.
acceptance_criteria: Returned URLs are sorted reverse-chronologically by contentModificationDate
displayName strips the `.md` extension from the filename
Read and write methods bracket security-scoped resource access
Shared RelativeDateTimeFormatter accessible without re-instantiation on each call

handoff_summary.completed: ShoppingListFiles enum implemented with: discover(in:) scanning for .md files and sorting reverse-chronologically, displayName(for:) stripping .md extension, readText(from:) returning optional String, writeText(_:to:) throwing on I/O failure, and dateFormatter static lazy property. All I/O methods bracket startAccessingSecurityScopedResource / stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource. No third-party dependencies.
handoff_summary.remaining: Downstream beads: ShoppingListsView, ShoppingListCardView, ShoppingListDetailView, ShoppingListItemRow, ShoppingListAisleGrouper, AisleIconMap, AisleCatalog, CreateShoppingListAlert, AddItemSheet, EditItemAlert, and modifications to ShoppingListsTab.swift and CookbookAppApp.swift.
handoff_summary.risks: None identified. The new file introduces no API surface collisions and creates the ShoppingLists/ directory for the first time, so no merge conflicts with sibling beads are expected as long as they use distinct filenames within that directory.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent to verify acceptance criteria against the new helper.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: The ShoppingLists/ directory is newly created by this bead. Sibling beads writing files there will not conflict as long as they use distinct filenames.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used a caseless enum (namespace pattern) consistent with RecipeDiscovery. Security-scoped access is called on the URL passed to each method rather than always requiring a separate folder URL parameter, matching the pattern in RecipesFolderStore.saveBookmark. Resource values for sorting are fetched inside the security-scope access block so they are evaluated before the defer fires.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests added (tester agent responsibility). Key coverage targets: discover returns only .md files, sort order is reverse-chronological, displayName strips .md, read/write round-trip correctness, and formatter singleton identity.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: writeText uses atomically:true which writes to a temp file then renames; this is safe for local files but may behave differently on some network-mounted volumes. readText returns nil on any error without propagating the failure reason to callers.

conflict_risks: The ShoppingLists/ directory is newly created by this bead. Sibling beads writing files there will not conflict as long as they use distinct filenames.
